claim: Circuit Paul Ricard's official Driving Experiences program offers four main routes: GTDrive supercars, EasyMonneret motorcycle training, Winfield Racing School Formula and two-seater passenger laps, and on-site karting.
quote: GTDRIVE - Realize your dream and drive the most beautiful GT and Supercars! ... Winfield Racing School - What if you became a race driver for a day? ... Karting Circuit Paul Ricard - Race against the clock at the wheel of new-generation go-karts!

claim: GT Drive at Paul Ricard's Driving Center (1.6 km piste) lets guests drive a Ferrari 296 GTB, Lamborghini Huracán, Porsche 992 GT3, Audi R8 V10 or McLaren 570S, with starter packages from around €74–€143 including instructor, insurance and SP98 fuel.
quote: Ferrari 296 GTB - Starting at €143.40 ... Lamborghini Huracán - From €143.40; features V10 engine, 640 cv, 335 km/h top speed ... Sessions include insurance, SP98 fuel, and services of a certified instructor, lasting approximately 90 minutes.

claim: OK Corral, the largest amusement park in southern France, lies only 4 km from Circuit Paul Ricard in Cuges-les-Pins and runs an April 4–November 1, 2026 season with ~30 Western-themed rides for ages from toddlers to thrill-seekers, including the Pioneer coaster (500 m, 65 km/h) and 2025's new Aqua Ranch water-play zone.
quote: The famous Castellet racing circuit is only 4 kilometers away ... The park OK Corral is open from April 4 to November 1, 2026 ... Pioneer (2018): Unique 500-meter roller coaster at 65 km/h ... Aqua Ranch (2025 addition): New water play zone for accompanied children under 110cm.

claim: Île des Embiez is reached year-round by a 12-minute ferry from Le Brusc (Six-Fours), with summer service also from Sanary (June 6 – Sept 26, 2026); adult day tickets run €10–€21 and the under-3s travel free, with no fixed return time.
quote: Adults: €10–€21 ... Under 3: Free ... From Port du Brusc (12-minute crossing, year-round) ... From Sanary (20-minute crossing, summer only): Service runs from June 6 to September 26 ... Your ticket is valid for the entire day, for both the outward and return journeys, with no set timetable.

claim: Île des Embiez is a Blue-Flag, Natura-2000-listed Paul Ricard island with 90% of Mediterranean plant species, a 360-degree-view fort, snorkel-friendly coves, a bakery, restaurants and summer tourist-train plus bike rentals — a low-key family day out.
quote: 90% of Mediterranean plant species ... It holds Blue Flag eco-label status and belongs to the Natura 2000 European network ... A fort offering 360-degree panoramic views ... Exceptional snorkeling opportunities in the surrounding seabed ... Bike rentals available; a tourist train operates in summer.

claim: The Institut Océanographique Paul Ricard aquarium, housed inside Fort Saint-Pierre on Embiez, displays ~100 Mediterranean species (groupers, lobsters, seabream, gorgonians) in habitat tanks, though the fort, museum and shop are currently closed for renovation.
quote: Some one hundred species from the shallow coastal waters of the north-western Mediterranean are presented in tanks that recreate their natural habitats ... The Fort Saint Pierre aquarium, museum and shop are currently closed in order to carry out work, for an indefinite period.

claim: Île de Bendor, Paul Ricard's other private island just off Bandol port, reopens on May 1 2026 under Zannier Hotels with three guesthouses (Delos, Soukana, Madrague) plus restaurants, building on Ricard's 1958 wine-and-spirits museum legacy.
quote: He established a wine and spirits museum that was inaugurated in 1958 ... After a period of closure, its doors will reopen on May 1, 2026. The revival is being spearheaded by Zannier Hotels ... three accommodation options—Delos, Soukana, and Madrague houses—plus multiple restaurants and bars.

claim: Bendor's Universal Exposition of Wines and Spirits, opened by Paul Ricard on 12 July 1958, historically opened to the public only in July and August.
quote: The Exposition Universelle des Vins et Spiritueux was a museum dedicated to alcoholic beverages on the island of Bendor. The museum was opened on 12 July 1958 by Paul Ricard, the owner of the Île de Bendor. The museum is open to the general public only during July and August.

claim: Aqualand Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer, located ~10–15 km from Le Castellet between La Ciotat and Bandol, opens its 2026 season from Saturday 20 June to Sunday 6 September.
quote: The park will be open from Saturday, June 20 to Sunday, September 6, 2026 ... Aqualand is situated 900 meters from the port and beach of Les Lecques on the commune of Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer.

claim: Plage des Lecques in Saint-Cyr-sur-Mer is a 1.4-km lifeguarded family beach with mixed sand-and-pebble zones, a children's club, beach volleyball and seasonal kids' animations.
quote: 1.4 km de long ... un terrain de beach-volley et quelques animations pour les enfants ... Club enfants ... Plage surveillée en saison.

claim: Bandol's Plage de Renécros is a sheltered bay of rare fine white sand with a gentle slope, lifeguard, paddle boats and snack bars — widely cited as the town's best family beach.
quote: a real paradise for the kids ... fine white sand, which the site emphasizes is very rare in this region ... two dams that create an almost natural swimming pool ... paddle boats, restaurants, and accessible facilities.

claim: La Ciotat's Plage Lumière is one of four main family beaches in the resort, with gentle slope, summer lifeguards and accessibility ramps for reduced-mobility visitors.
quote: Plage Lumière in La Ciotat is one of the 4 main family beaches in the seaside resort ... a sandy beach has a lifeguard station open in summer and access ramps for people with reduced mobility ... highly sought after by families with children because the gentle slope facilitates swimming.

claim: Calanc'O Kayak Paddle in Cassis runs guided sea-kayak and stand-up-paddle outings into the Calanques National Park for all skill levels, putting in at 9 avenue Joseph Liautaud.
quote: Calanc'O Kayak Paddle is a French company located in Cassis that offers guided sea kayaking and stand-up-paddleboarding for anyone wishing to explore an area protected by national park status by sea ... 9, avenue Joseph Liautaud – 13260 CASSIS.

claim: Île Verte off La Ciotat offers signature dive sites — Calanque d'Isserot (≤20 m, beginner-friendly), Calanque au Canon with a sunken cannon at 12 m, and the south-west Petit Moure wall to 32 m with groupers, moray eels, lobsters and octopus.
quote: Calanque d'Isserot is the cove of Île Verte most distant from the port of La Ciotat, with the interior not exceeding 20 meters ... a cannon positioned on Île Verte fell down the cliff into 12 meters of water ... Petit Moure: Southwest of Île Verte, a small wall descends to 32 meters ... groupers, moray eels, lobsters, and octopus.

claim: The Mont Faron téléphérique in Toulon climbs to 584 m above sea level with a transparent floor, runs daily Feb–Nov (except some Mondays in Feb/Mar) and combines with the Fauverie zoo on a Pass Téléphérique/Fauverie (€18 adult / €13 child).
quote: a transparent floor (which is revealed only in the eyes of the passengers with the least vertigo!) ... March-April: 10 am-1 pm and 1:30-6 pm; May-June: 10 am-1 pm and 1:30-7 pm; July-August: 10 am-7:45 pm daily ... Combination passes offered with the Fauverie (zoo) and Memorial attractions.
